definition: FastAPI is a fast Python web framework for building APIs from type hints, with automatic validation and OpenAPI docs.
details: Created by Sebastián Ramírez in 2018; built on Starlette and Pydantic.

explainer.lead: How to install FastAPI, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.inAi: The common way to put a Python model behind an HTTP endpoint that a JavaScript front end can call.
explainer.jsNote: Python only — but its whole purpose is to be called from other languages, e.g. fetch("/predict") from JavaScript.
